shortDescription: Create, update, or delete VAST Quota resources

options.name: create_dir
options.description: Set to true to create the directory if the directory was not created yet.

options.name: create_dir_mode
options.description: Unix permissions mode for the new directory

options.name: default_email
options.description:
Emails are sent to users if and when they exceed their user/group quota limits. default_email is a default email
address that is used instead of a user's email address in the event that no email address is found for the user
on a provider and no email suffix is set.

options.name: default_group_quota
options.description:
If is_user_quota is true, this parameter can be used to specify a default rule for all groups. If not specified,
each group is only limited individually by group rules applied to the group through group_quotas.

options.name: default_user_quota
options.description:
If is_user_quota is true, this parameter can be used to specify a default rule to limit individual quota usage
for all users. If not specified, each user is only limited individually by user and group rules applied to the
user through user_quotas and group_quotas.

options.name: enable_alarms
options.description:
True by default. Enables alarms on relevant events for user and group quotas. Applicable only if is_user_quota is
true. Raises alarms reporting the number of users that exceed their quotas and when one or more users is/are
blocked from writing to the quota directory.

options.name: enable_email_providers
options.description:
Set to true to enable querying Active Directory and LDAP services for user emails when sending user notifications
to users if they exceed their user/group quota limits. If enabled, the provider query is the first priority
source for a user's email. If a user's email is not found on the provider, a global suffix is used to form an
email. If no suffix is set, default_email is used.

options.name: grace_period
options.description:
Quota enforcement grace period. An alarm is triggered and write operations are blocked if storage usage continues
to exceed the soft limit for the grace period. Format: [DD] [HH:[MM:]]s

options.name: group_quotas
options.description: Group Quotas

options.name: hard_limit
options.description: Storage usage limit beyond which no writes will be allowed.

options.name: hard_limit_inodes
options.description:
Number of directories and unique files under the path beyond which no writes will be allowed. A file with
multiple hardlinks is counted only once.

options.name: iam_role_quotas
options.description: Iam Role Quotas

options.name: id
options.description: Resource ID for direct lookup. Mutually exclusive with name-based identification.

options.name: inherit_acl
options.description: Indicates whether the directory should inherit ACLs from its parent directory

options.name: is_physical_quota
options.description: Whether to limit by Physical Capacity. Default is Logical. Cannot be updated. Requires VMS 5.5 or later.

options.name: is_user_quota
options.description: Is User Quota

options.name: name
options.description: Quota name

options.name: path
options.description: The directory path on which to enforce the quota

options.name: quota_groups_ids
options.description: Quota Groups Ids Requires VMS 5.5 or later.

options.name: soft_limit
options.description: Storage usage limit at which warnings of exceeding the quota are issued.

options.name: soft_limit_inodes
options.description:
Number of directories and unique files under the path at which warnings of exceeding the quota will be issued. A
file with multiple hardlinks is counted only once.

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state of the resource.

options.name: tenant_id
options.description: Tenant ID

options.name: user_quotas
options.description:
An array of user quota rule objects. A user quota rule overrides a default user quota rule for the specified
user.

options.name: vms
options.description: VAST VMS connection parameters.

options.name: wait
options.description: Wait for async operations to complete.

options.name: wait_timeout
options.description: Timeout in seconds for async operations.
